name: Mcpl
description:
Tail and display MCP server stderr logs in real time.

mcpl monitors log files for all configured MCP servers or a specific server, streaming output with timestamps, server name prefixes, and log-level icons (❌ ERROR, ⚠️ WARN, ℹ️ INFO). Run without arguments to watch all servers at once, or use --server to focus on one.
longDescription:
Ships **1 command**, `tail` (Tail and display MCP server stderr logs in real time) and **1 hook**, `hooks.json`.

Installs with `claude plugin install mcpl@claude-community` from `yn01/claude-plugins` (`plugins/mcpl`).

MCPサーバーのstderrログをリアルタイムでtailして整形表示するClaude Codeプラグイン。
